title.full: Declining an unknown Trusted Contact request

summary.text: Decline the request in the “Trusted Contacts” section under your Account settings.

steps.name: Decline the request
steps.text: Go to the “Trusted Contacts” section under your Account settings and decline the request.

example_phrasings: An unknown party has appointed me as their Trusted Contact. What should I do?
Someone I do not know made me their Trusted Contact
How do I decline an unknown Trusted Contact request?

sources.page_title: An unknown party has appointed me as their Trusted Contact. What should I do?

quotes.text: If you have received a Trusted Contact appointment request from a person not known to you, you can decline the request at the “Trusted Contacts” section under your Account settings.
you can decline the request at the “Trusted Contacts” section under your Account settings.
